subject: [PATCH 48/60] mm/madvise: restrict reclaim advice to reclaim-capable memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new function, `folio_allows_reclaim()`, which checks if a folio's node permits reclaim. It then uses this function to restrict the behavior of MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, and MADV_FREE operations to only common memory nodes.
